known_limitation: The metric is comparable as evidence that the branch emitted a reconstruction objective, but it should not be read as an R2 head trained on the exact simple baseline feature split.
normalization_policy: This is not the single-episode/128-baseline R2 metric. It is a model-branch reconstruction-quality probe backed by the verified held-out future-window feature reconstruction error.
score_policy: Derived from the verified Cosmos3-Nano future-window package metric. The source package directly reports held-out feature_reconstruction_error; this artifact maps it onto task 10 as an inverse reconstruction-quality score 1 / (1 + error) so the matrix can retain its higher-is-better convention.
title: Cosmos3-Nano Future Window Modality Reconstruction Probe
